cases.scope: Finite observation-contract model, not an implemented subtree observer or native liveness proof. Actual interpreted TFIB and interrupt2 reach the unchanged no-file-completion window; the runner buffers child output. Root-only visibility can expire despite result-bearing internal work. Noise may not renew the clock. A proposed result-bearing internal observer must preserve truthful clocks and require the entire original workload before completion. The native run's internal work, root dependency liveness, and whether its timeouts are true stalls remain unknown; this model neither authorizes an unchanged retry nor closes a native gate.
